title: HTTP Signature Keys (draft-hardt-httpbis-signature-key) test vectors
description: Deterministic test vectors for every Signature-Key scheme and algorithm that aauth-rust and aauth-go both implement, with negative vectors for the draft's MUST-reject rules.

Every vector publishes the request, the signature base verbatim, the header fields signing added, the keys with their private material, the documents the verifier resolves against, and the result the pinned drafts fix.

Category 1 is key handling, 2 verify-only (randomized signatures: verify, never recompute and compare), 3 reproduce-the-bytes (deterministic signatures), as dickhardt/signature-key issue 25 defines them.
Evaluate each vector at its now, with the verifier configuration below. vectors/signature-key/README.md describes every member and how to reproduce the set.

vectors.title: jwks_uri whose JWKS also holds an ML-DSA-44 key; kid selects the Ed25519 key

expect.basis: signature-key line 235: select the member matching kid; MUST NOT fail because an unselected member names a kty or alg the verifier does not implement

vectors.title: jwks_uri whose only key is ML-DSA-44, signed with it

expect.basis: signature-key line 233 and protocol Verification step 6: a verifier that does not implement the AKP key type MUST reject it with unsupported_algorithm and MUST NOT fail in an undefined manner; one that implements ML-DSA-44 verifies

provenance.note: Signed by the harness: neither library signs with ML-DSA-44.

vectors.title: hwk signature that does not cover signature-key

expect.basis: signature-key line 1301: verifiers MUST reject requests where signature-key is not covered; protocol Verification step 2: invalid_input with required_input

provenance.note: Signed by the harness: both libraries always cover signature-key.

vectors.title: hwk member carrying a kid parameter

expect.basis: signature-key line 295: the kid parameter MUST NOT be used; no code is fixed, and any failure is a 401 with Signature-Error (protocol Verification)

provenance.note: Signed by the harness: both libraries emit hwk members only for the signing key's own JWK, with alg and without kid.

vectors.title: hwk member naming the polymorphic EdDSA

expect.basis: signature-key lines 203 and 211; protocol Verification step 6: unsupported_algorithm for a polymorphic alg

provenance.note: Signed by the harness: both libraries emit hwk members only for the signing key's own JWK, with alg and without kid.

vectors.title: hwk member without alg

expect.basis: signature-key lines 203 and 293: alg is REQUIRED and a verifier MUST reject a JWK without it; protocol Verification step 6: unsupported_algorithm if alg is absent

provenance.note: Signed by the harness: both libraries emit hwk members only for the signing key's own JWK, with alg and without kid.

vectors.title: hwk OKP key naming ES256

expect.basis: signature-key line 229; protocol Verification step 6: invalid_key when kty disagrees with alg

provenance.note: Signed by the harness: both libraries emit hwk members only for the signing key's own JWK, with alg and without kid.

provenance.note: Signed by the harness: both libraries emit hwk members only for the signing key's own JWK, with alg and without kid.

vectors.title: self-jwt carrying a cnf claim

expect.basis: signature-key lines 629 and 651: a self-jwt MUST NOT contain cnf; invalid_jwt (line 1078) for a JWT that fails verification

provenance.note: Not signed by aauth-rust: refused (HTTP 422): invalid_jwt (invalid Signature-Key JWT: check compact serialization, required claims, and the assertion signature).

vectors.title: jkt-jwt whose iss is not the thumbprint of its header jwk

expect.basis: signature-key lines 339 and 424: iss MUST equal the thumbprint URI of the header jwk; invalid_jwt (line 1078)

provenance.note: Not signed by aauth-rust: refused (HTTP 422): invalid_jwt (invalid Signature-Key JWT: check compact serialization, required claims, and the assertion signature).

vectors.title: cached member whose cid this verifier never issued

expect.basis: signature-key lines 1008-1014: cache_miss when a cache identifier cannot be resolved

provenance.note: Not signed by aauth-go: not offered: aauth-go presents only a cache identifier a verifier issued: NewCachedCredential takes a CacheGrant.

vectors.title: two signatures on one request, sig1 under hwk and sig2 under jwks, both Ed25519; the verifier is configured to verify sig1 and sig2

expect.basis: signature-key lines 173 and 181 leave the labels a verifier checks to application context, so this vector's verifier is configured to verify sig1 and sig2 in place of sig; lines 191 and 199: each signature has its own member keyed by its label, the complete Signature-Key is populated before any signature is created and each signature covers signature-key; line 177: the verifier selects each label's member, and each signature verifies over its own base

vectors.title: boundary, must verify: hwk signature whose created is 60 seconds ahead of the verifier clock, the edge of the 60-second window

expect.basis: protocol Verification step 3, line 2246: created MUST be within the verifier's signature validity window, 60 seconds by default. clock_skew is for a created further ahead than the window (signature-key line 1106); 60 seconds ahead is not further ahead

vectors.title: boundary, must verify: hwk signature whose created is 60 seconds before the verifier clock, the edge of the 60-second window

expect.basis: protocol Verification step 3, line 2246: created MUST be within the verifier's signature validity window, 60 seconds by default. invalid_signature is for a created older than the window (signature-key line 1114); 60 seconds old is not older

vectors.title: boundary, must verify: jwt whose exp is one second after the verifier clock

expect.basis: signature-key line 566 (reject if the token has expired) and line 1086 (expired_jwt: exp is in the past); protocol Common JWT Verification step 3, line 2317: exp is in the future by the verifier's own clock, with no skew tolerance. exp one second after now has not expired

vectors.title: boundary, must verify: jwt whose nbf equals the verifier clock

expect.basis: the drafts add no nbf rule; RFC 7519 Section 4.1.5 accepts a JWT when the current time is after or equal to nbf, and protocol line 2313 verifies the agent token per RFC 7519

vectors.title: boundary, must verify: jkt-jwt whose exp is one second after the verifier clock

expect.basis: signature-key line 428 (validate exp) and line 1086 (expired_jwt: exp is in the past, for jkt-jwt too). exp one second after now has not expired

vectors.title: boundary, must verify: jkt-jwt whose nbf equals the verifier clock

expect.basis: the drafts add no nbf rule; RFC 7519 Section 4.1.5 accepts a JWT when the current time is after or equal to nbf, and signature-key line 1198 verifies a jkt-jwt per RFC 7519

vectors.title: boundary, must verify: self-jwt whose exp is one second after the verifier clock

expect.basis: signature-key line 647 (reject if the token has expired) and line 1086 (expired_jwt: exp is in the past, for self-jwt too). exp one second after now has not expired

vectors.title: boundary, must verify: self-jwt whose nbf equals the verifier clock

expect.basis: the drafts add no nbf rule; RFC 7519 Section 4.1.5 accepts a JWT when the current time is after or equal to nbf, and signature-key line 1196 verifies a self-jwt per RFC 7519

vectors.title: jwks, ML-DSA-44, signed with the FIPS 204 deterministic variant (rnd all zeros) so the signature reproduces

expect.basis: signature-key line 231: ML-DSA-44 is a fully-specified alg used as-is; line 233 and protocol Verification step 6: a verifier that does not implement the AKP key type MUST reject it with unsupported_algorithm and MUST NOT fail in an undefined manner; one that implements ML-DSA-44 verifies

vectors.optional: reproducing the bytes needs ML-DSA-44 signing with the FIPS 204 deterministic variant (rnd all zeros, empty context); most libraries do not expose that option, so a signer without it may skip the byte comparison. Verification is graded as verify-or-reject either way

provenance.note: Signed by the harness: neither library signs with ML-DSA-44.
